title: That $520 Canon Kit Is Cheap. It Is Also a Dead End.
excerpt: Costco is selling a Canon R100 kit for $520, the cheapest new mirrorless camera you can buy. That is the only thing it has going for it. Spend a little more, or buy used, and get a camera that can grow with you.

title: Focus on the Background and Your Subject Starts to Disappear
excerpt: Nearly everything you learn about focus says keep the subject sharp. Reverse it, a soft figure against a sharp scene, and the image turns dreamy without new gear, slow shutters, or anything smeared on the lens.

title: Choose Your Next Lens by the Story, Not the Spec Sheet
excerpt: Wide for landscapes, long for wildlife, something in between for the rest. That is how most of us shop for lenses. Photographer Brenda Bergreen argues the decision starts somewhere else entirely: with what you want the photograph to say.
